I request that I be properly classified as a media requester. I am an associate editor at Reason Magazine who has written numerous articles on topics of public interest, and I am requesting these documents in an editorial capacity. communications.communication:
To Whom It May Concern:

Pursuant to the Georgia Open Records Act, I hereby request the following records:

At the November 24, 2026 City Council meeting, the City Manager said that he and the City Attorney would be finalizing “in the coming days” a specific policy governing automated license plate readers (ALPRs). The remark comes about 1 hour 46 minutes into the meeting recording.

Every draft or version of that ALPR policy that exists on the date of this request, in the form it was shared. This includes any version the City Manager’s Office or the City Attorney’s Office sent to the Police Department, Procurement, or the Mayor and Aldermen. Any model policy, template, or example policy from another city, a state agency, a professional association, or a vendor (including Flock Safety, Axon, and Motorola Solutions) that the City received or used while preparing the draft.
Email metadata only (sender, all recipients including cc and bcc, subject line, and date and time) for any email to or from the City Manager’s Office or the City Attorney’s Office, from October 1, 2026 through the date of this request, that attached or sent a draft ALPR policy or a model policy covered by items 1 and 2.

These records are likely held by the City Manager’s Office and the City Attorney’s Office. Copies may also be with the Police Department or Procurement, so please search each. I would like item 1 first. If items 2 or 3 will take longer or cost more, please send item 1 and give me the timeline and estimate for the rest. I am glad to narrow them. communications.subject: Freedom of Information Act Request: DHS Secretary Mullin's November 2026 Trip to Azerbaijan
communications.communication:

Pursuant to the Freedom of Information Act, I hereby request the following records:

All records created, sent, received, or maintained by the Office of the Secretary of Homeland Security (including the Secretary, the Chief of Staff, the Executive Secretariat, the Office of Strategy, Policy, and Plans, the Office of International Affairs, and the Office of Public Affairs) concerning the Secretary's November 2026 official travel to the Republic of Azerbaijan, including his meeting with President Ilham Aliyev in Baku on or about November 22, 2026. communications.subject: California Public Records Act Request: SDI-HIDTA settlements and fiduciary agreements
communications.communication:
To Whom It May Concern:

Pursuant to the California Public Records Act, I hereby request the following records:

Background: Tommy LaNier and Valerie E. Taylor worked in the office of the San Diego-Imperial High Intensity Drug Trafficking Area (SDI-HIDTA). They each sued the City of Chula Vista related to their employment. Court filings state Mr. LaNier was on the City's payroll, and that the Chula Vista Police Department was a designated fiscal agent (fiduciary) for SDI-HIDTA.

1. Every settlement agreement, release, and stipulation resolving any claim by Mr. LaNier or Ms. Taylor against the City or any City officer or employee, with all attachments.
2. Every agreement, memorandum of understanding, grant award, or designation under which the City or the Chula Vista Police Department served as fiscal agent, fiduciary, or grantee for SDI-HIDTA or the California Border Alliance Group. This includes any terms on personnel, liability, indemnification, insurance, or legal defense.

The litigation has ended, so the pending-litigation exemption no longer applies. Settlement agreements of a public agency are public records. Copley Press, Inc. v. Superior Court, 63 Cal. Where records exist as spreadsheets or CSV files, please produce them in that format. If Village Of Chicago Ridge did not use the Barnacle during this period, please say so.

The requested documents will be made available to the general public, and this request is not being made for commercial purposes.

If you withhold or redact any record, please cite the specific FOIA exemption for each withholding.

Sincerely,

HCvP
